title: Plan for Mobilising and Coordinating Healthcare Resources in Mass Casualty Incidents
what_it_is: Plan for Mobilising and Coordinating Healthcare Resources in Mass Casualty Incidents

sections.label: Mass casualty incident response plan
sections.summary: The Government has a national inter-agency response plan for mass casualty incidents, with MOH coordinating casualty management and regular training and exercises.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Government has a national inter-agency response plan for mass casualty incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Under this national response plan, the Ministry of Health (MOH) oversees and coordinates the management of casualties at the incident site, and at public hospitals and polyclinics.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Our national response plan is similar to the French national emergency response plan.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: It involves the deployment of command and field medical teams to the incident site as well as management of resources and capacity at our healthcare institutions to attend to casualties.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We conduct regular training, exercises and reviews within the healthcare family as well as with other agencies to prepare for such incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For instance, in October 2017, MOH participated in Exercise Northstar, a multi-agency exercise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: MOH's current plans are to ensure our public hospital capacity is able to cater to such incidents but, from time to time, when the need arises, we do tap on the resources of the private sector and involve them in consultations and our engagements.
